body: Pure JavaScript OCR for more than 100 languages.
plain_description: **Turn images into searchable text in more than 100 languages.** Use it in a browser or a Node.js application to recognize text from images.
technical_description: Tesseract.js is a JavaScript library that brings the Tesseract OCR engine to browsers and Node.js by wrapping a WebAssembly port. It recognizes text in images and supports workers and schedulers for processing. It does not support PDF files or modify the recognition model.
title: Tesseract.js
